model.name: HLLC-MUSCL plus positivity-preserving shock-basis DKAN subcells
model.learned_activation: enable at cells <= 200; exact fixed conservative MC fallback above 200 cells
hard_constraints: zero change to every conservative cell mean

benchmark.note: These exact state tuples were not used for training or model development.

primary_metric.definition: fixed conservative-MC primitive geometric-mean L2 divided by resolution-gated DKAN value
primary_metric.aggregate: geometric mean over 18 case-resolution pairs per seed, then median over five seeds
primary_metric.success: median gain >= 1.00 and bootstrap 95% lower confidence bound >= 0.95

secondary_gates.RH_no_material_degradation: DKAN RH residual <= 1.20 times fixed-MC RH residual

unified_cross_equation_gate.definition: geometric mean of the frozen Burgers-v4 median gain and this Euler median gain
unified_cross_equation_gate.claim_boundary: This is an equal-equation hybrid score, not evidence that each equation improves by 20%.

overall_claim_boundary: The method is WENO/exact-Riemann supervised and finite-volume coupled. It must not be described as a data-free PINN, and the final ten-seed float64 confirmation remains separate.
